title.en: Four Ways to Pick a Battery

brief.zh: 维修站来了同一批电池。亲手试四种取法，看看找到的电池和剩下的电池有什么变化。
brief.en: Try four ways to choose from the same batch of batteries. See which battery you get and what stays in the batch.

concept.zh: 列表按索引，栈按顶端，队列按先后，字典按名字
concept.en: Index with a list, take the top with a stack, serve in order with a queue, and look up a name with a dictionary

title.en: A list finds items by position

body.zh: 托盘上的位置从 0 数起。索引 1 会取到第 2 块 C，原来的摆放顺序还在。
body.en: Tray positions start at 0. Index 1 reads the second battery, C, and leaves the tray in order.

title.en: A stack takes from the top

body.zh: 按到达顺序往上叠，最后放的 D 在最上面。用 pop() 拿走它，下一块才露出来。
body.en: Stack the batteries in arrival order. The last one, D, ends up on top. pop() removes it and exposes the next battery.

title.en: A queue serves the first arrival

body.zh: 先到的 A 在队头，后到的排在后面。这个短队列用列表演示，pop(0) 拿走队头。
body.en: A arrived first, so it waits at the front. Later arrivals line up behind it. Here a list shows the short queue, and pop(0) removes its front item.

title.en: A dictionary looks up a name

body.zh: 名字是字典的键。用 B 号来查，会找到 B 的电池记录；这条记录仍留在字典里。
body.en: The battery name is the dictionary key. Looking up B reads its battery record and leaves that record in the dictionary.

caption.zh: 列表按位置读取，索引 1 对应第 2 块。
caption.en: A list reads by position. Index 1 is the second slot.

caption.zh: 栈拿走最顶上一块，也就是最后放进去的。
caption.en: A stack removes the top battery, which was added last.

caption.zh: 队列先取最早到的一块。
caption.en: A queue removes the battery that arrived first.

caption.zh: 字典用名字直接找到对应记录。
caption.en: A dictionary uses the name to find the matching record.

prompt.zh: 维修站要先处理最早送来的电池。用哪种结构最合适？
prompt.en: The repair station needs to work on the first battery that arrived. Which structure fits best?

feedback.zh: 队列把最早到的一块放在队头，先取队头。
feedback.en: A queue keeps the earliest arrival at the front and serves it first.

execution.source:
batteries = read_battery_batch()
position = scan()
picked = batteries[position]
say(picked["name"])

sources.dictionary:
directory = read_battery_directory()
name = read_battery_key()
picked = directory[name]
say(picked["name"])

prompt.zh: 维修单要求先处理最早送到的电池。
prompt.en: The work order asks for the battery that arrived first.

prompt.zh: 维修单只写了名字 R，请找到这块电池的记录。
prompt.en: The work order only gives the name R. Find that battery’s record.

prompt.zh: 维修单要求读出托盘从左边数第 3 块电池。
prompt.en: The work order asks for the third battery from the left on the tray.

prompt.zh: 按到达顺序把电池一块块往上叠，只拿最顶上的一块。
prompt.en: Pile the batteries in arrival order, then take the one at the top.
